profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Truemed
profile.summary:
Full-stack web developer, problem-solver.
Ex-GitHub, Duke alum

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Constantly strengthening the Authentication experience at GitHub - maintaining and improving account security features and flows like multi-factor authentication.
Contributing to and leading feature work within the github.com monolith, expanding the feature set of an internal authentication microservice, and working across multiple deployment environments (including Enterprise offerings).

Technologies: Ruby on Rails, MySQL, Golang

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designing and leading epics, providing technical feedback and help to teammates, remodeling parts of Rev's data models, continuously and efficiently delivering on complex issues. Working on mission-critical initiatives that significantly expand the features Rev offers to Enterprise customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Speccing and implementing technically challenging issues, mentoring junior teammates, giving technical feedback, leading epics. Helping lead initiatives that enable Rev's Enterprise customers to be more productive, more easily navigate the website, and collaborate with other users.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Creating features for Rev's enterprise customers to make their experience using Rev the best it can be.

Stack: ASP.NET MVC (C#), Microsoft SQL Server (Transact-SQL), React + TypeScript

positions.title: Software Technical Intern
positions.description: Summer internship as technical intern for site administrators. Development of website and web application projects, company internal tools, and work on technical indicators

positions.title: Software Technical Intern
positions.description: Summer internship with project management group working on technical indicators, writing Perl scripts, Excel macros, and SQL database queries

positions.title: Undergraduate Technical Intern
positions.description: Summer learning internship – applications of object-oriented programming, data structures, exposure to Python, SQL, and application frameworks

certifications.name: SQL Server Fundamentals training (Query Tuning, Index Tuning, Parameter Sniffing, TempDB)
certifications.title: SQL Server Fundamentals training (Query Tuning, Index Tuning, Parameter Sniffing, TempDB)
